        "Owned Linux integration is real code, not a vendor-only change. Compile-time en-US strings are not full locale resources. Third-party dependency source excluded. Current Rust code has later Fluent adaptation and preference gates, not attributed to this landing.",

MyTray/unused FluentValue/mut arguments are removed. The unfinished icon-model comment is gone. lib.rs contains platform guards but no crate-level threading documentation.",
